title: The Fourth, 2002
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: The dock, white fireworks in black and white, Gully in the apron, and beside him the uncle's lawn chair, empty since February 2001. The two of them say what he'd have said. The dog under the chair.

panels.composition: The dock at night, fireworks as white bursts, GULLY and WOOD on the planks, an empty lawn chair beside Gully.

panels.composition: GULLY looking up, not at the chair.

panels.composition: The empty chair, and under it BARNABY, asleep, the bursts reflected in the water.
